skill.name: maxart-creative-studio
skill.description: Turn a product brief, campaign idea, or reference image into MaxArt-ready image and video prompt packs, shot lists, style directions, and creative variation plans. Use when the user wants ads, social creatives, product shots, stylized edits, text-to-image prompts, image-to-video motion plans, or reusable prompt systems intended to be rendered in MaxArt.ai.
skill.summary: Create structured MaxArt-ready image and video prompt packages from briefs and reference assets.
skill.author: jerrylearner187

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives. The URL and Markdown reference are documentation, while the flagged prose does not perform system reconnaissance or external command execution.

static_findings.snippet: - Read `references/prompt-patterns.md` when you need reusable prompt skeletons for ads, product shot
- Avoid vague praise words unless they change the image.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 91 contains a Markdown reference path, `references/prompt-patterns.md`, in an instruction to read documentation. It does not invoke Ruby, a shell, or any external command.
Line 10 identifies https://maxart.ai as the primary site for the skill. This is descriptive documentation and contains no network request or data transfer instruction.
Line 84 advises users to avoid vague praise words in prompts. The prose does not inspect, enumerate, or collect information about the host system.

content.value_statement: Creative teams often have strong ideas but lack consistent prompts, variations, and production notes. This skill turns a brief or reference asset into organized MaxArt-ready image and video direction.
actual_capabilities: Extracts goals, audiences, platforms, formats, styles, brand constraints, and calls to action from a creative brief.
Creates structured image prompts with subjects, actions, environments, composition, lighting, and style.
Develops image-to-video motion directions covering camera movement, pacing, transitions, and ending frames.
Builds campaign packs with core prompts, variations, negative constraints, shot lists, and channel adaptations.
Separates fixed and changeable elements when planning reference-image transformations.
Highlights common generation risks such as warped hands, broken logos, text artifacts, and product geometry drift.
limitations: It produces creative instructions and does not render images or videos.
It does not guarantee exact MaxArt controls, model behavior, or output fidelity.
It cannot verify trademark rights, likeness permissions, or licensing for supplied assets.
Results depend on the completeness of the brief and the quality of reference materials.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Ads
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into hero image prompts, supporting variations, negative constraints, and platform-specific creative directions.

use_cases.title: Plan Social Video
use_cases.description: Develop short-form image-to-video concepts with scene openers, camera movement, pacing, transitions, and final frames.

use_cases.title: Build Visual Systems
use_cases.description: Convert a reference asset and style requirements into repeatable prompt patterns, shot lists, and controlled creative variations.

prompt_templates.title: Starter Product Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three MaxArt image prompts for [product] aimed at [audience]. Include subject, setting, composition, lighting, style, aspect ratio, and one negative-constraint list.

prompt_templates.title: Reference Transformation
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this reference asset, create a transformation plan for [goal]. List what must remain fixed, what may change, three prompts, likely failure points, and recommended aspect ratios.

prompt_templates.title: Short-Form Motion Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three MaxArt image-to-video concepts for [campaign]. For each, specify the opening scene, camera move, subject motion, background motion, pacing, transition, ending frame, and one variation.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Channel Campaign System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a MaxArt campaign pack for [offer] across [channels]. Define the master visual system, hero and supporting asset prompts, short-form video concepts, channel adaptations, and a testing matrix ordered by impact.

output_examples.input: A sustainable skincare brand needs a calm Instagram launch image for a new serum.
output_examples.output: Creative direction: A clear glass serum bottle on wet stone beside soft green leaves, photographed in diffused morning light. Prompt set: three compositions for a square feed post, with exclusions for distorted labels, extra containers, harsh glare, and unreadable text.

output_examples.input: Create a product reveal video for a compact wireless speaker.
output: Opening: The speaker rests on a matte pedestal in a quiet studio.
Motion: A slow orbit reveals the texture while a narrow light sweep moves across the grille.
Ending: The camera settles on the product and leaves clean space for a short headline.

output_examples.input: Adapt a shoe reference image into a consistent campaign system for web, social, and retail screens.
output_examples.output: Fixed elements: shoe silhouette, sole shape, logo placement, and brand palette. Changeable elements: background, props, lighting, and camera angle. Deliverables: hero prompts, supporting shots, vertical adaptations, motion concepts, and a prioritized test matrix.

best_practices: Provide the audience, platform, format, aspect ratio, visual style, brand constraints, and call to action.
Separate core prompts from variations, exclusions, and production notes so each instruction stays easy to test.
State fixed and changeable reference-image elements before requesting transformations.
anti_patterns: Do not request exact interface controls or undocumented MaxArt features.
Do not combine contradictory styles, camera directions, or constraints in one oversized prompt.
Do not prioritize visual novelty over conversion clarity for commercial creative.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images or videos?
faq.answer: No. It creates production-ready prompts, shot lists, motion directions, and testing notes for use in MaxArt.ai.

faq.question: What information should I include in a brief?
faq.answer: Include the goal, audience, offer, platform, format, aspect ratio, visual style, brand constraints, and call to action.

faq.question: Can it work from a reference image?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies elements to preserve, elements that may change, and likely problems such as logo or geometry drift.

faq.question: Can it plan image-to-video work?
faq.answer: Yes. It specifies scene openings, camera movement, subject motion, background motion, pacing, transitions, and ending frames.

faq.question: Can it adapt one idea for multiple channels?
faq.answer: Yes. Campaign packs can group hero assets, supporting assets, video concepts, and adaptations by channel.

faq.question: Does it guarantee a specific rendered result?
faq.answer: No. Rendered results depend on the generation model, available controls, reference quality, and prompt interpretation.
